references.text: Concerns wild animals that God sends as punishment, corresponding to 'teeth of wild beasts' in Deuteronomy 32:24
Hunger as God's judgment on disobedience, parallel to 'wasted by hunger' in the original text
Poisonous snakes sent as punishment, corresponding to 'venom of crawling things' mentioned in the verse
Plague and disease as curses for breaking the covenant, parallel to pestilence and fever in Deuteronomy 32:24
Hunger and plague mentioned as God's judgment, corresponding to famine and pestilence in Moses' song
Wild animals as part of God's four judgments, parallel to the teeth of wild beasts
Plague (reshef) mentioned as an attendant of God in judgment; the same Hebrew word is used
Plague and disease sent over Egypt, using similar language about God's judgments
Plague that destroys at noon, using the word 'qetev' (destruction) as in Deuteronomy 32:24
Sword, famine, plague, and wild animals as four instruments of punishment, corresponding to the four curses in Moses' song
